cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded the blanket like you. Proper picnic seats. Have a sandwich; it's just like our last afternoon here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm folding up to leave. Last time you said we needed space. Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, plenty of space once it's folded. Put the basket between us; shall I pour the tea?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I won't eat or drink until you answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, we'll leave the basket closed. How's your allotment doing? Still fighting the slugs?
